newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in to support 890 won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in to support 890 won - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea intervened in the interbank foreign exchange market on Tuesday, offering to buy dollars at 890 won, dealers said.
The dollar rose to 890.60 won after the intervention. It opened at 890.80 but fell to 890.00 in line with the yen's strengthening against the dollar in world markets.
Dealers said the central bank immediately stepped into the market to cap the strengthening of the local currency.
The Bank of Korea does not confirm its interventions.
